_comment: Reviewed, deliberate deviations of canon_ref.py from research/state/raw/round-004/07-work/canon_map.json (output of the research canon_ref.py). Any other disagreement with canon_map fails the research-pin check.

deviations.why: Spike q4-008 (F8 canon.trailing_slash = accept): a trailing slash is its own canonical form, distinct from /admin (RFC 3986). Research silently stripped it, which is a repair outside the RFC 3986 6.2.2 safe set (CANON-2). Before q4-008 this oracle answered 308 -> /admin.

Spike q4-008 (F8 canon.encoded_non_ascii_path = accept_opaque): %80-%FF octets are accepted as opaque uppercase-hex bytes when they are strict UTF-8 and NFC. U+FF21 FULLWIDTH A is NFC (only NFKC folds it), so the path is accepted and is byte-distinct from /admin; it can only alias /admin behind an upstream that NFKC-folds paths, which is CANON-8 (per-upstream folding profile, not checked here).

Research canon_ref.py validated A-labels with Python's IDNA2003 codec (h.encode().decode('idna')), i.e. IDNA on ingress, which contradicts its own rule and rejects valid IDNA2008 A-labels (nameprep maps U+00DF to 'ss'); its own config example lists xn--fa-hia.de as a vhost. We check RFC 3492 structure only and match the A-label byte-exactly.
